name: Kilnband
flavour: Fired once, kept warm ever since.
note: Fire resistance, strength and a little life and energy shield.

name: Furnace Loop
flavour: A ring made of the last coal in the grate.
note: Same stat line as its sibling: fire resistance and strength with small life and energy shield.

name: Smelter's Ring
flavour: Everything it touches runs hot, and then runs.
note: Same stat line as its siblings.

name: Gilded Tithe
flavour: Pay the toll and the road pays you back.
note: Huge item rarity for the cost of elemental resistance.

name: Whisperer's Cap
flavour: It hears every spell before it is spoken.
note: Attack and cast speed, mana regeneration, energy shield and movement speed on a circlet.

name: Magpie Gauntlets
flavour: Anything that glitters ends up in the palm.
note: Armour and evasion with item rarity and all elemental resistances, at a movement speed cost.

name: Pauper's Rapier
flavour: Takes your coin and gives you an edge.
note: Physical damage and crit multiplier with life on hit, paid for with item rarity and a thrusting base.

name: Triune Rod
flavour: Three fires, one answer.
note: Added fire, cold and lightning damage to spells with strong spell crit.

name: Stillbreath Sash
flavour: Hold it, and the shield holds with you.
note: Energy shield, recharge rate and intelligence on a belt.

name: Eclipse Helm
flavour: The light goes out of the room when it is worn.
note: +1 to socketed gems with armour and percentage attributes.

name: Cinderfeather Quiver
flavour: Each arrow leaves a smoulder.
note: Added fire to bow attacks with attack speed and physical converted to fire.

name: Gutter Stiletto
flavour: Quick, cheap and always wet.
note: Crit, attack speed, bleed chance and added physical on a dagger.

name: Tallow Hammer
flavour: It melts what it fails to break.
note: Fast heavy mace: attack speed, crit and stun threshold with fire and lightning resistance.

name: Butcher's Frock
flavour: Stitched from the offcuts.
note: Area of effect and area damage with evasion and energy shield.

name: Gravecap Circlet
flavour: The highest point of a very low place.
note: Strength, mana, resistances, experience and elemental damage.

name: Rockfall Quiver
flavour: Arrows that land like stones.
note: Added physical to bow attacks, stun duration and a lower enemy stun threshold, slower projectiles.

name: Coinbearer Buckler
flavour: The coin on its face has never been spent.
note: Life, regeneration, life leech, lightning resistance, block and movement speed on a buckler.

name: Wizened Gloves
flavour: Spells come easier, and slower.
note: Spell damage and energy shield at a cast speed cost.

name: Shard of Slumber
flavour: Cold, calm and impossible to wake.
note: Cold resistance, mana, regeneration and immunity to freeze and chill.

name: Lidless Eye
flavour: It has never blinked and never will.
note: All attributes and item rarity for 20% less life, with immunity to stun.

name: Emberstride Boots
flavour: The pack runs hot.
note: Movement speed, fire resistance, chance to ignite and damage against ignited enemies.

name: Prism Crown
flavour: Every light bent into a ring.
note: +1 to socketed gems, armour and energy shield and all four resistances.

name: Maulwright's Club
flavour: A club for people who have run out of arguments.
note: Huge physical damage, stun duration and threshold, melee damage against bleeding enemies.

name: Snare of Plenty
flavour: Bait the road and it will feed you.
note: Attributes, energy shield, movement speed and item quantity on low life.

name: Frostbreak Sledge
flavour: Winter, with a handle.
note: Slow heavy mace converting a half of physical to extra cold, big stun duration and leech.

name: Hailbreak Hammer
flavour: The same song, sung before the thaw.
note: Physical damage and stun threshold on a sledgehammer, a lower-level sibling.

name: Coldfang Quiver
flavour: Hungry and always cold.
note: Added cold to attacks, life on hit, attributes and area of effect.

name: Eelskin Quiver
flavour: Slick, quick and mean.
note: Life on hit, attack speed, area of effect and added damage to attacks per ten points of each attribute.

name: Glacier Coffin
flavour: A cold place to be buried alive.
note: Strength, intelligence, cold resistance, armour and energy shield, immune to chill, long chill duration on enemies.

name: Charging Idol
flavour: It runs ahead of the one who wears it.
note: Projectile damage and speed, attack speed, accuracy and movement speed.

name: Totem Ward
flavour: A little luck on a thong.
note: A cheaper sibling: projectile damage and speed, accuracy, strength and movement speed.

name: Sage's Hammer
flavour: Heavy thoughts, heavier head.
note: Physical damage, life, mana and area damage and effect on a mace at a movement cost.

name: Pile of Odds
flavour: A little of everything, none of it earned.
note: Damage, all attributes, item rarity and all resistances at random strength.

name: Skinner's Knife
flavour: It takes only what it needs, and that is the strength.
note: Physical damage, added physical, strength and life on hit.
